title: Objection Story Selector
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Challenger Selling
description: Step-through practice in which learners match five common customer objections to the Price, Timing, Competitor, Risk or Authority story type and see an example story for each.

learningObjectives: Select the appropriate objection story type (Price, Timing, Competitor, Risk, Authority) for different customer objections.
prerequisites: Handling Objections with Stories section of Chapter 4

keyQuestions: Select the appropriate objection story type (Price, Timing, Competitor, Risk, Authority) for different customer objections.
commonMisconceptions: Any story can address any objection.
Arguments work better than stories for objections.
assessmentOpportunities: Correct story type for all five objections.
Learner can distinguish a Price objection from a Competitor objection that mentions price.
